title: Days of the week
description:
Read numbers until the input ends. For each one from 1 to 7 print that day's name (1 is Monday, 7 is Sunday); for anything else print `No such day`. For the input `1 7 3 0 9 -2 5`:

```
Monday
Sunday
Wednesday
No such day
No such day
No such day
Friday
```

Use a **jump table** like the lesson's: subtract 1 so the days become 0 to 6, check the range with **one unsigned** comparison, and jump with `jmp [register + index*8]`.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .data
monday: db      "Monday", 10, 0
none:   db      "No such day", 10, 0

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        call    read_int
        test    rdx, rdx
        jz      .exit
        cmp     rax, 1
        jne     .bad
        lea     rdi, [rel monday]
        call    print_str
        jmp     .next
.bad:
        lea     rdi, [rel none]
        call    print_str
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .data
d1:     db      "Monday", 10, 0
d2:     db      "Tuesday", 10, 0
d3:     db      "Wednesday", 10, 0
d4:     db      "Thursday", 10, 0
d5:     db      "Friday", 10, 0
d6:     db      "Saturday", 10, 0
d7:     db      "Sunday", 10, 0
none:   db      "No such day", 10, 0

        section .rodata
days:   dq      _start.mon, _start.tue, _start.wed, _start.thu, _start.fri, _start.sat, _start.sun

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        call    read_int
        test    rdx, rdx
        jz      .exit
        dec     rax                     ; 1..7 becomes 0..6
        cmp     rax, 6
        ja      .bad                    ; unsigned: too big or negative
        lea     rcx, [rel days]
        jmp     [rcx + rax*8]
.mon:   lea     rdi, [rel d1]
        jmp     .print
.tue:   lea     rdi, [rel d2]
        jmp     .print
.wed:   lea     rdi, [rel d3]
        jmp     .print
.thu:   lea     rdi, [rel d4]
        jmp     .print
.fri:   lea     rdi, [rel d5]
        jmp     .print
.sat:   lea     rdi, [rel d6]
        jmp     .print
.sun:   lea     rdi, [rel d7]
        jmp     .print
.bad:   lea     rdi, [rel none]
.print: call    print_str
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall
